name: Templar Untainted's tooltip bills a positive physical damage reduction (#9895)
contract: Untainted (talent 705298) triggers 705299, whose effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_TAKEN (physical) with
EffectBasePoints -11 and EffectDieSides 1, so $705299m1 renders -10. aura_ascension_templar_lifecycle subtracts
0.1 x Stamina from that amount, so the buff reduces physical damage taken by 10 + 0.1 x Stamina. The client text
'${$705299m1+$STA*0.1}' added the negative base to the Stamina term and read 'by -0' at about 100 Stamina.
Expected: the streamed talent text bills '${-$705299m1+$STA*0.1}' and no longer carries the old sum, the buff
text bills '${-$m1+$STA*0.1}', and a level-29 buff's effect 0 is a reduction of at least 10.
